stage1.title: Hello
stage1.subtitle: Tell us your name, then take a quick climb.

pre.title: What AI Global is
pre.body: MIT Professional Education-backed. One quarter, one domain, real AI systems. Q1 2026 is Marketing. The climb is your warm-up — we'll fill in the rest as you go.

stage1.ctaHint: 100 m. Soft hint shown for the first few holds.

outcome.winBody: While you were climbing — AI Global runs in quarterly cycles around one domain. Each quarter ships GloLabs (peer-reviewed case studies) and GloGames (interactive lessons). You'll meet GloGames in Stage 4.
outcome.failBody: No score-keeping. The climb is just to get a feel. Read on while you catch your breath: AI Global runs in quarterly cycles around one domain. Q1 2026 is Marketing.
outcome.next: When you're ready, Stage 2 is the first intro you'd post in Discord.

stage2.title: Your first intro
stage2.subtitle: One line you'd actually post.

pre.title: The Discord, briefly
pre.body: First stop is #👋introduce-yourself. The format is light: name, role, country, what you're here for. Pick a lane below and we'll draft a starter line in your name. You can shuffle, or write your own.

stage2.ctaHint: Same wall, no hints this time.

outcome.winBody: Now the intro. Three programs to know before you post: GloLabs (case studies — Vol 1 covered Marketing), GloGames (interactive AI lessons), SPC (paid 4-course governance program). The Discord routes you to all of them.
outcome.failBody: The wall got you. The intro's still ready — copy and post it, then come back for another go. Programs to know: GloLabs (case studies), GloGames (interactive lessons), SPC (governance courses).
outcome.lovedPrompt: Optional — one line about what you took away from this so far. Goes on the share card.
outcome.lovedPlaceholder: e.g. The community-first framing is what hooked me.
outcome.next: Stage 3 is the longer post for #find-a-buddy.

stage3.title: Find a buddy
stage3.subtitle: The longer post. We'll format it for you.

pre.title: How buddies work
pre.body: #🤝find-a-buddy expects a specific format — location, role, what you'd teach, what you'd learn. Fill the form below and we'll produce a copy-paste-ready post. Then climb as high as you can.

fullPicture.title: Programs worth knowing
fullPicture.body: GloLabs publishes peer-reviewed AI case studies each quarter. GloGames makes the lessons interactive (you'll see one in Stage 4). SPC is the four-course governance program. Volunteer paths: Ambassador, AI.MRKT (learn-then-teach), case-study authoring, contributor pathway. None of this is required to be part of the community — but it's how it grows.

stage3.ctaHint: No target. Just go as high as you can.

outcome.posterBody: That's the run. Your buddy post is ready — pick a channel and drop it in.
outcome.lovedPrompt: Optional — what did you actually like about this? One line. Goes on the share card.
outcome.lovedPlaceholder: e.g. Felt like a community I'd want to lurk in.
outcome.next: Stage 4 is one more game — about how a neural net actually learns.

stage4.title: One more game
stage4.subtitle: How a neural net actually learns.
stage4.body: GloGames' first release: six floors covering Inputs → Weights → Neurons → Activation → Loss → the learning loop. About ten minutes if you're curious.

stage5.title: Coming soon
stage5.subtitle: Something else lives here.
stage5.body: Reserved for whatever the next quarter brings — a new game, a contribution path, or your own project drop. Check back when Q2 starts.
